title: On Composite Adaptive Continuous Finite-Time Control of a class of Euler-Lagrange systems
summary: In this paper, we propose several set-point control schemes for achieving finite-time regulation in a class of Euler--Lagrange systems with $n$ degrees of freedom and uncertain potential energy. The proposed controllers are based on composite adaptive control approaches. Each control scheme consists of two main components: a Proportional--Derivative (PD)-based nonlinear feedback term and a finite-time parameter estimation law.
